page.overview:
Who is Pietro Fittipaldi?

Pietro Fittipaldi da Cruz (born 25 June 1996 in Miami, Florida, United States) is an American-born Brazilian racing driver. He is a grandson of two-time World Champion Emerson Fittipaldi and nephew to Christian Fittipaldi and Max Papis. He has been part of the Ferrari Driver Academy, and has raced in DTM and in the F3 Asian Championship.

Following Romain Grosjean's heavy accident at the 2020 Bahrain Grand Prix, it was announced that Fittipaldi would be making his race debut at the 2020 Sakhir Grand Prix, replacing Grosjean.

For 2021, Pietro is set to compete in Indycar with Dale Coyne Racing, sharing the car with Romain Grosjean, and serving as a test driver for Haas.
